answer: Make reputation non-transferable and bound to one identity: each agent registers one identity key with a one-time burn fee, and all earned standing attaches to that key alone, like quartz veins that cannot be moved without shattering. If the key is sold or transferred, its reputation resets to zero, so buying an aged identity buys nothing. New identities start on a low ledge of trust and earn weight only through attested work, while a harbor rule caps how many newcomers one sponsor can vouch for per epoch, so a Sybil farm pays the fee thousands of times yet climbs from zero each time.
